name: source-poor-copy
prompt: Make this product description more compelling, in 45–75 words. Only known facts: Bracken is a desk lamp with a replaceable LED module, a steel base, and a two-year warranty. Source: 'Bracken is a transformative lighting solution that seamlessly elevates every workspace. Its innovative design is a testament to our unwavering commitment to excellence.' No testing data, customer stories, price, dimensions, country of manufacture, or ergonomic or sustainability certifications are available. Return only the revised copy.
expected_output: Specific copy using only supported features with no invented benefits.
assertions: Includes replaceable LED module, steel base, and two-year warranty accurately.
No invented light-quality, comfort, durability, environmental, manufacturing, certification, price, or user-experience claims.
45–75 words and no assistant or editing commentary.
